title: Accessibility impact-effort priorities
goal: A university team can identify quick wins and larger projects for accessibility work.

rubric.must: Named accessibility initiatives are visibly positioned on impact and effort axes.
The quick-win and major-project regions are visually distinguishable.
Both low-effort and high-effort initiatives are visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the matrix/quadrant exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The matrix clearly shows all five named initiatives on labeled impact and effort axes. The quick-win and major-project regions are distinguishable, and the quadrant structure and initiative labels are readable without visible overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: All five named initiatives appear as bubbles positioned within the matrix, with impact on the vertical axis and effort on the horizontal axis.
The upper-left Quick wins region and upper-right Major projects region are visibly distinct and labeled.
Low-effort initiatives appear on the left, including Fix alt-text audit and Rename help links; high-effort initiatives appear on the right, including Add caption editor and Rebuild discussion tool.
All five initiative labels are legible and unobstructed.
A central vertical and horizontal divider form four clearly delineated quadrants, with axis labels and direction cues visible.
